# unifi_maps (Data Source)

The `unifi_maps` data source retrieves all maps (floor plans) configured on a site.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "unifi_maps" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `site` (String) The name of the UniFi site where this resource should be applied. If not specified, the default site will be used.

### Read-Only

- `maps` (Attributes List) The list of maps. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--maps))

<a id="nestedatt--maps"></a>
### Nested Schema for `maps`

Optional:

- `site` (String) The name of the UniFi site where this resource should be applied. If not specified, the default site will be used.

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of this resource.
- `lat` (String) The latitude of the map centre.
- `lng` (String) The longitude of the map centre.
- `map_type_id` (String) The Google map type.
- `name` (String) The name of the map.
- `offset_left` (Number) The horizontal offset of the map image, in pixels.
- `offset_top` (Number) The vertical offset of the map image, in pixels.
- `opacity` (Number) The opacity of the map image.
- `selected` (Boolean) Whether this map is the currently selected map.
- `tilt` (Number) The tilt angle of the map, in degrees.
- `type` (String) The type of map.
- `unit` (String) The distance unit of the map.
- `upp` (Number) The units-per-pixel scale of the map.
- `zoom` (Number) The zoom level of the map.
